item.title: Iranian officials: American citizens are considered legitimate targets
item.description:
Two senior Iranian officials, including a senior Revolutionary Guards official, confirmed to The New York Times that Tehran is preparing to harm American diplomats and government officials.
According to the two, Israel and the United States have killed dozens of senior Iranian officials and several members of their families. They claim that as a result, American citizens are also considered "legitimate targets."

item.title: Iran reports meeting with Mojtaba Khamenei amid questions over his whereabouts
item.description: Iran's judiciary reports a meeting between its chief and Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, who has not appeared publicly since March.

item.description: A major fire breaks out at Hitler's former Alpine retreat in Bavaria, “the Eagle’s Nest", with 200 emergency personnel deployed and a suspect detained as police investigate the cause.

item.title: Hitler's 'Mein Kampf' found at home of suspect in Paris-area shooting
item.description: French police discover Hitler's "Mein Kampf" at the home of a suspect in a shooting near Paris that killed one and wounded five, including a critically injured girl.

item.title: Riyadh airport to resume flights despite renewed Houthi threats
item.description: Riyadh's main airport prepares to resume domestic and international flights Sunday as the Houthis renew threats to target the facility following recent attacks.

item.title: Report: US military has strike plans ready for Iran
item.description: CENTCOM has reportedly prepared several options for renewed strikes against Iran after the midterms, pending Trump’s approval.

item.title: Did you remember to turn back your clocks? Israel 'falls back' to Winter Time
item.description: Israel switches to Winter Time, turning clocks back one hour from 2:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m. Winter Time will remain in effect until March 26, 2027.

item.title: Israel to restrict Palestinian Arab workers' entry, close land crossings on Election Day
item.description:
In accordance with a situational assessment, it was decided that, starting Sunday and through Monday, Palestinian Arab workers will not be permitted to enter Israeli communities in Judea and Samaria and the Jordan Valley for work, with the exception of industrial zones and a limited number of other approved areas.
Additionally, following a recommendation by the security establishment, the political echelon approved a ban on the entry and exit of Palestinian workers throughout Judea and Samaria and the Jordan Valley, including industrial zones, as well as the closure of all land crossings throughout Election Day, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026.

item.title: Is Tom Barrack fit to represent America in the Middle East?
item.description: When an American envoy says antisemitism “didn’t exist," suggests Zionism became a problem in 1948 and repeatedly gives Israel's adversaries the benefit of the doubt, the question is no longer one unfortunate choice of words. It is one of judgment. Opinion.

item.title: Two towns and six farms planned in response to shooting attack
item.description: The Har Hebron Regional Council has announced plans to establish two new communities and six agricultural farms in the southern Hebron Hills following Friday's deadly terrorist attack near Hebron.

item.title: Shas in turmoil: Senior Sephardic rabbi calls for election boycott
item.description: Rabbi Moshe Tzadka, a leading Sephardic haredi rabbi, instructs followers not to vote for Shas over the military draft dispute. Aryeh Deri scrambles to enlist senior rabbis to reverse the decision.

item.title: Fall back! Israel turns clocks back tonight
item.description: Israel switches to winter time overnight as clocks move back one hour at 2:00 a.m., giving Israelis an extra hour of sleep but bringing earlier sunsets.

item.title: Iran reportedly ready to target submarine cables if war resumes
item.description: Iran has developed detailed plans to attack undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the United States and Israel launch renewed military strikes.
